title: Hyena Ear
summary: Extract three Hyena Ears for the Ashes used to make Potion of Speed.

fields.Alchemy: Three ears make Ashes of Hyena Ear. Mix the Ashes with any Salt for Potion of Speed.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by hyenas and gnolls, found in alchemy labs, and sold by Derryth Bonecloak.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
